Test_Description: Read all GPIO gp0 registers (gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_10) after reset and verify that the read values match the default/reset values defined in the register specification.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System reset (hreset_n) applied.
2. GPIO0 instance selected (#define GPIO0 1).
3. Base address = 0xA001A000.
Test_Steps:
1. Apply system reset.
2. For each register in addr_array (gp0_gpio_8 at offset 0x0, gp0_gpio_9 at offset 0x4, gp0_gpio_10 at offset 0x8), read the register using read_reg(addr).
3. Compare the read value against the corresponding default_value_array entry.
4. Report PASS if all match, FAIL otherwise.
Expected_Result:
All GPIO registers return their reset default values:
- gp0_gpio_8 (0x0): 0x00100000 (io_ctrl=1, all others=0)
- gp0_gpio_9 (0x4): 0x00100000
- gp0_gpio_10 (0x8): 0x00100000
Pass_Fail_Criteria:
PASS: All register reads match default values.
FAIL: Any register read does not match its default value.
Register_Fields: data_in[0](RO); intr_raw_sts[1](RO); intr_clr[16](WO); pedge_intr_en[17](RW); nedge_intr_en[18](RW); level_sel[19](RW); io_ctrl[20](RW2); dout[21](RW2)
Register_Access_Types: RO; RO; WO; RW; RW; RW; RW2; RW2
Default_Values: data_in=0; intr_raw_sts=0; intr_clr=0; pedge_intr_en=0; nedge_intr_en=0; level_sel=0; io_ctrl=1; dout=0

Test_Description: Write test patterns to all writable fields of GPIO gp0 registers (gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_10) and read back to verify that the written values are correctly stored. Only RW and RW2 fields are tested; RO and WO fields are excluded from write verification.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System reset (hreset_n) applied.
2. GPIO0 instance selected (#define GPIO0 1).
3. Base address = 0xA001A000.
Test_Steps:
1. Apply system reset.
2. For each register in addr_array, write a test pattern using write_reg(addr, pattern & write_mask).
3. Read back the register using read_reg(addr).
4. Mask the read value with read_mask and compare against expected.
5. Report PASS if all match, FAIL otherwise.
Expected_Result:
Written values are correctly read back for all writable fields:
- pedge_intr_en[17], nedge_intr_en[18], level_sel[19] accept RW writes.
- io_ctrl[20], dout[21] accept RW2 writes (hardware feedback may differ).
- data_in[0] and intr_raw_sts[1] are RO and reflect hardware state.
Pass_Fail_Criteria:
PASS: All writable register fields read back the written value (masked by read_mask).
FAIL: Any writable field does not read back the expected value.

Register_Access_Types: RO; RO; WO; RW; RW; RW; RW2; RW2

Test_Case_Name: GPIO Level Select Interrupt - Active High
Test_Description: Configure GPIO pins 8-39 in input mode with level_sel=1 (active high) and pedge/nedge disabled. Apply a high-level stimulus and verify that: (a) per-GPIO intr_raw_sts is set, (b) group interrupt status (gp0_intr1_intr_sts1) reflects the correct GPIO, (c) interrupt is routed through LSS sysreg raw_stcr1 gpio0_intr (bit 1), (d) GIC IRQ 87 fires, and (e) interrupt clears correctly.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System reset (hreset_n) applied.
2. GPIO0 instance selected (#define GPIO0 1).
3. Base address = 0xA001A000.
4. GIC IRQ 87 enabled.
5. LSS sysreg intr_en1 gpio0_intr bit enabled.
Test_Steps:
1. Enable GIC IRQ 87 for GPIO0.
2. Enable LSS sysreg interrupt: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, 0x00000002).
3. For each GPIO i (0 to 31):
   a. Write 0x00180000 to gp0_gpio_(8+i) — sets io_ctrl=1 (input), level_sel=1 (active high), pedge/nedge=0.
   b. Enable group interrupt: write_reg(gp0_intr1_intr_en1, 1<<i).
   c. Stimulate high level on GPIO pin (write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM 0xA0243ffc).
   d. Wait for ISR (Default_IRQHandler).
   e. In ISR: read gp0_gpio_(8+i), verify intr_raw_sts[1]=1.
   f. Read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1, verify bit i is set.
   g. Clear interrupt: write 0x00110000 to gp0_gpio_(8+i) (intr_clr=1).
   h. Verify cleared: read gp0_gpio_(8+i) == 0x100001.
   i. Disable group interrupt, verify gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 == 0.
   j. Clear LSS sysreg: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, 0x00000002), verify cleared.
   k. Clear GIC IRQ 87.
Expected_Result:
For each GPIO pin (8-39):
- intr_raw_sts[1] = 1 when high level detected.
- gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 bit[i] = 1.
- After clear: gp0_gpio register = 0x100001.
- gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 = 0 after disable.
- LSS raw_stcr1 gpio0_intr cleared.
- GIC IRQ 87 fires and clears.
Pass_Fail_Criteria:
PASS: All 32 GPIO pins generate and clear level interrupts correctly.
FAIL: Any GPIO pin fails to generate interrupt, or interrupt clear fails, or group/sysreg status mismatch.
Register_Fields: data_in[0]; intr_raw_sts[1]; intr_clr[16]; level_sel[19]; io_ctrl[20]; G8_intr_en..G39_intr_en[0..31]; G8_intr_sts..G39_intr_sts[0..31]; gpio0_intr[1]
Register_Access_Types: RO; RO; WO; RW; RW2; RW; RO; RAWSTCR1
Default_Values: All fields default to 0 except io_ctrl=1
LSS_Interrupt_Mapping: raw_stcr1 (offset 0x24): gpio0_intr at bit[1] (RAWSTCR1); intr_en1 (offset 0x28): gpio0_intr at bit[1] (INTREN1)
